title: Ellorrs Madak
caption: Ellorrs Madak (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your ••• aliens are deploy -1. Your Rep is immune to attrition and may not be captured. While you have alien characters of five different species on table, your battle destiny draws and Force drains are +2, and opponent’s battle destiny draws are –2. {alter}
lore: Like many Duros, Madak has natural piloting and navigation skill. Former scout. Freelance instructor. Makes runs to important trade worlds Celanon, Byblos and Yaga Minor.
